# splitsecure_group (Data Source)

Resolves an org group by its group_s2r or by its name. Set exactly one of them. A name lookup errors when no group or more than one group has the name; set source to tell apart groups that share a name. A name is mutable, so prefer group_s2r for a stable key. The system Everyone group is not a regular group; read everyone_group_s2r from the splitsecure_organization data source instead.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_s2r` (String) Group s2r URI. Set it to look the group up by s2r, or read it after a lookup by name. Also usable directly as a grant grantee.
- `name` (String) Group name. Set it to look the group up by exact name in the provider's org. Mutable server-side, so do not treat it as an identifier.
- `source` (String) Where the group is managed: "local", "scim", or "system". Set it to "local" or "scim" to narrow a lookup by name.
